The '''ANy-20 active sensor transceiver''' was manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] and used in [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] class spaceships such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. It provided ship-to-ship jamming capabilities in addition to the required communications capabilities.<ref name="SWS" /> It worked in conjunction with a Fabritech [[ANq-51 sensor array computer/Legends|ANq-51 sensor array computer]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
